blocks.text: Sawal jaisa hona chahiye (durust kar ke): Initial value problem \(\left(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}\right)dx - x\,dy = 0\); \(x = 1\) par \(y = 0\) ko hal karein. Kitab mein pehla \(dx\) ghalti se \(dy\) chhapa hai aur condition \(x = 0\) par di gayi hai; neeche wajah dekhiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Is sawal mein do chhapai ki ghaltiyan hain. (1) Equation mein \(dy\) do dafa chhapa hai; pehla \(dx\) hona chahiye: \(\left(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}\right)dx - x\,dy = 0\). Jaisa chhapa hai waisa sirf \(\left(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2} - x\right)dy = 0\) kehta hai, jo woh homogeneous equation nahi jo is section mein chahiye. (2) Condition \(x = 0\) par \(y = 0\) se constant maloom nahi ho sakta: \(x = 0\) par \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}{x}\) defined hi nahi, har solution curve \(y = \frac{Cx^2}{2} - \frac{1}{2C}\) line \(x = 0\) ko \(y = -\frac{1}{2C} \neq 0\) par kaat'ti hai, aur general solution \(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = Cx^2\) mein \((0, 0)\) rakhein to har \(C\) ke liye \(0 = 0\) aata hai. Answer key ka jawab \(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = x^2\) us curve ka hai jo \((1, 0)\) se guzarti hai, is liye hum condition \(x = 1\) par \(y = 0\) le kar hal karte hain.

blocks.prompt: 24 Solve the initial value problem \(\left(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}\right)dx - x\,dy = 0\) [printed with \(dy\) in place of the first \(dx\)]; \(y = 0\) when \(x = 1\) [printed as \(x = 0\); see the correction above].
blocks.explanation:
Pehle sawal ko theek karna zaroori hai: pehla \(dy\) asal mein \(dx\) hai. Theek karne ke baad har term ki degree 1 hai, is liye equation homogeneous hai.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur ek condition. Find kya karna hai? Particular solution.
Kitab ki condition \(x = 0\) par di gayi hai, lekin wahan equation defined hi nahi, is liye us se \(C\) nahi nikalta; hum \(x = 1\) par \(y = 0\) lete hain jo key ke jawab se milta hai.
Rule kaunsa? \(y = vx\); beech mein \(\int \frac{dv}{\sqrt{1 + v^2}}\) wala standard integral lagega.
Plan: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) nikalna, \(y = vx\), variables alag, integrate, \(v\) wapas, condition lagana, aur aakhir mein seedhi shakal aur tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\left(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}\right)dx - x\,dy = 0\), \(x = 1\) par \(y = 0\) (durust kiya hua).
Maloom karna: particular solution.
Tareeqa: Homogeneous equation (Section 4.2.2): \(y = vx\); phir initial condition se \(C\). Shuru ka point \(x = 1 > 0\) hai, is liye hum \(x > 0\) le kar kaam karenge.

\(\frac{dy}{dx}\) likhein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}{x}\]
Kyun: \(x\,dy\) ko doosri taraf le ja kar \(x\,dx\) se divide kiya. \(y\), \(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}\) aur \(x\): sab ki degree 1 hai (square root ke andar degree 2, root lene se 1), is liye equation homogeneous hai.

\(y = vx\) rakhein
\[\sqrt{x^2 + v^2x^2} = x\sqrt{1 + v^2}\]
\[v + x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = v + \sqrt{1 + v^2}\]
\[x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = \sqrt{1 + v^2}\]
Kyun: Root ke andar se \(x^2\) common nikala; \(\sqrt{x^2} = x\) sirf tab hai jab \(x > 0\), isi liye humne \(x > 0\) liya. Phir dono taraf ka \(v\) cancel ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{x^2}\) asal mein \(|x|\) hota hai; sign ka khayal na rakhein to negative \(x\) par ghalti ho sakti hai.

Variables alag kar ke integrate karein
\[\int \dfrac{dv}{\sqrt{1 + v^2}} = \int \dfrac{dx}{x}\]
\[\ln\left(v + \sqrt{1 + v^2}\right) = \ln x + \ln C\]
\[v + \sqrt{1 + v^2} = Cx\]
Kyun: Standard integral \(\int \frac{dv}{\sqrt{v^2 + 1}} = \ln\left|v + \sqrt{v^2 + 1}\right|\) hai. \(v + \sqrt{1 + v^2}\) hamesha positive hota hai (root \(|v|\) se bara hai), is liye modulus nahi chahiye aur \(C > 0\).

\(v = y/x\) wapas rakhein (general solution)
\[\dfrac{y}{x} + \dfrac{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}{x} = Cx\]
\[y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = Cx^2\]
Kyun: \(x > 0\) ke liye \(\sqrt{1 + \frac{y^2}{x^2}} = \frac{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}{x}\). Phir dono taraf \(x\) se multiply kiya to fractions khatam ho gaye.

\(x = 1\) par \(y = 0\) lagayein
\[0 + \sqrt{1 + 0} = C(1)^2\]
\[C = 1\]
\[y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = x^2\]
Kyun: Diya hua point general solution mein rakha to \(C\) ki value mil gayi; yahi answer key wala jawab hai.

Seedhi (explicit) shakal
\[\sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = x^2 - y\]
\[x^2 + y^2 = x^4 - 2x^2y + y^2\]
\[y = \dfrac{x^2 - 1}{2}\]
Kyun: Root akela kar ke dono taraf square kiya; \(y^2\) dono taraf se cancel ho gaya, phir \(2x^2y = x^4 - x^2\) ko \(2x^2\) se divide kiya. Yani yeh curve ek parabola hai.

Chhapi hui condition kyun kaam nahi karti
Aam taur par \(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = Cx^2 - y\) se
\[y = \dfrac{Cx^2}{2} - \dfrac{1}{2C}\]
\(x = 0\) par \(y = -\frac{1}{2C}\) aata hai jo kabhi zero nahi, yani koi solution curve \((0, 0)\) se nahi guzarti.
Kyun: Isi liye condition kisi aise point par deni chahiye jahan \(x \neq 0\) ho; \(x = 0\) par to equation hi defined nahi.

Tasdeeq
\(y = \frac{x^2 - 1}{2}\) ke liye:
\[x^2 + y^2 = \left(\dfrac{x^2 + 1}{2}\right)^2\]
is liye \(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = x^2\) aur \(\frac{y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}{x} = x = \frac{dy}{dx}\) \(\checkmark\); \(y(1) = 0\) \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: \(x^2 + \frac{(x^2 - 1)^2}{4} = \frac{4x^2 + x^4 - 2x^2 + 1}{4}\), jo poora square hai. Curve equation aur condition dono poori karti hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = x^2\), yani \(y = \frac{x^2 - 1}{2}\) (durust condition \(x = 1\) par \(y = 0\) ke saath)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 28 par chhapa hai, 24 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 28 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Key ka jawab \(y + \sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = x^2\) durust kiye hue sawal (\(x = 1\) par \(y = 0\)) ke liye sahi hai.
